strategies.overview: Chillingly powerful is quite the accurate description for Kyurem-B. With an Attack stat that eclipses even Calyrex-I, BoltBeam coverage, Dragon Dance, and Teravolt to boot, Kyurem-B is easily capable of ripping through bulky teams, with even Necrozma-DM struggling to stand up to its Fusion Bolt with Tera Electric and Miraidon's Electric Terrain. Its solid natural bulk also allows it to set up against passive Pokemon like Gliscor and Arceus-Water lacking Will-O-Wisp, and it threatens the specially defensive Ground-types used to stave off Miraidon like Arceus-Ground, Ting-Lu, and Clodsire. Unfortunately, Kyurem-B's part-Ice typing is a massive hindrance defensively, limiting its opportunities to set up despite its solid natural bulk. It can also be outsped by Choice Scarf Koraidon even after a boost or picked off by priority like Arceus's Extreme Speed or Kingambit's Sucker Punch. It also is not exactly the fastest Pokemon in the world, which in conjunction with its meager defensive profile limits what Kyurem-B can accomplish against offensive teams.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Tera Fire with Tera Blast can be used to destroy Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C at +1 while also avoiding burns from Ho-Oh. However, it is largely unnecessary given how strong +1 Tera Electric Fusion Bolt is.

Checks and Counters

Arceus-Fairy: Arceus-Fairy can easily take everything Kyurem-B throws at it, has reliable recovery, and can threaten Kyurem-B with super effective Judgment or Will-O-Wisp.

Ho-Oh: Ho-Oh can survive +1 Fusion Bolt and threaten to burn Kyurem-B with Sacred Fire or phaze it with Whirlwind. Tera Fairy Ho-Oh also survives everything +1 Kyurem-B can throw at it.

Speed Control: Choice Scarf Koraidon outspeeds Kyurem-B even after a Dragon Dance and threatens it in return. Extreme Killer Arceus and Kingambit threaten to pick off Kyurem-B with Extreme Speed or Sucker Punch.

Residual Damage: Kyurem-B has no recovery and is vulnerable to all forms of residual damage, even being weak to Stealth Rock.

Steel-types: While they're not hard counters, Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C resist Icicle Spear, can take +1 Fusion Bolt, and retaliate with super effective STAB moves, and Necrozma-DM can heal off the damage. They must, however, be wary of Kyurem-B Terastallizing into an Electric-type.

Trick Room Pokemon: Pokemon like Necrozma-DM, Calyrex-I, and the rare Necrozma-DW can take boosted attacks from Kyurem-B and turn the tables on it with Trick Room.

Ditto: While it's rare, Ditto can reliably revenge kill Kyurem-B. It must, however, watch out for Substitute on dual screens teams.

movesets.name: Dragon Dance
movesets.description:
With Dragon Dance, Kyurem-B can boost its Attack to even greater levels while also fixing its Speed issue. Icicle Spear and Fusion Bolt provide perfect coverage in Ubers, and Fusion Bolt's power can be increased further with Tera Electric and Miraidon's Electric Terrain. Tera Electric is also useful for the Steel resistance it provides, allowing Kyurem-B to set up on and threaten Zacian-C and Necrozma-DM without Earthquake, which would normally check it quite easily. Loaded Dice makes Icicle Spear and Scale Shot reliably strong STAB moves. Scale Shot is usually preferred over Substitute thanks to Kyurem-B's meager defensive profile, but Substitute can be used on dual screens hyper offense teams where its defensive problems are mitigated to set up freely on Gliscor and Arceus-Water and avoid revenge killing attempts from Choice Scarf Koraidon and Extreme Killer Arceus. Jolly is usually the preferred nature to let Kyurem-B outspeed Zacian-C with one Speed boost and Choice Scarf Koraidon with two, but Adamant is superior on Sticky Web teams where its Speed issue is mitigated.

Due to being relatively weak without Terastallization and its defensive shortcomings, Kyurem-B fits best on hyper offense teams. Grimmsnarl's dual screens aid Kyurem-B further with setting up and even allows it to run Subsitute. Ribombee's Sticky Web mitigates Kyurem-B's Speed issue and allows it to run an Adamant nature. On both styles, Miraidon is a near-mandatory partner, setting up Electric Terrain for Kyurem-B to boost its Fusion Bolt and getting it in safely with U-turn. In return, Kyurem-B threatens Ground-types used to check Miraidon, like Gliscor, Ting-Lu, and Arceus-Ground. Necrozma-DM can serve as a check to Zacian-C and Arceus before Kyurem-B is ready to sweep, making it a good partner. Despite not being very apt defensively, Kyurem-B can switch into and set up on Kyogre once, making it a solid partner for Koraidon and Arceus-Ground. Kyurem-B also appreciates these Pokemon immediately threatening Necrozma-DM, which it can struggle against even if Necrozma-DM does not carry Sunsteel Strike.

movesets.name: Choice Band
movesets.description: Kyurem-B's main niche compared to competitors like Mega Garchomp and Ash-Greninja lies in its immensely spammable Glacial Lance, which hits most physical walls for at least neutral damage while also being non-contact to avoid Rocky Helmet and Burning Bulwark. Bolt Strike 2HKOes Fur Coat Water-types like Mega Slowbro and Dondozo in addition to Primordial Sea Registeel. U-turn eases prediction and chips walls like Mega Slowbro. Headlong Rush and V-create both target Steel-types like Zacian-C, with the former OHKOing Primordial Sea Registeel and the latter OHKOing Mega Steelix. Kyurem-B's main weakness is its vulnerability to Stealth Rock, making strong entry hazard removal mandatory. Due to Glacial Lance's excellent neutral coverage and Kyurem-B's raw power, it forces most physical walls to remain healthy to avoid being KOed the next time it attacks, making Strength Sap blockers like Magic Guard Blissey and Magic Bounce users fantastic teammates. Kyurem-B is also very slow for a wallbreaker, making fast Pokemon such as Ash-Greninja and Koraidon desirable. Imposter-proof Kyurem-B with Fur Coat Pokemon such as Arceus-Ghost and Mega Audino.

movesets.name: Dragon Dance
movesets.description:
• Kyurem-B serves as a fearsome physical sweeper, using its monstrous Attack stat to tear apart weakened teams. Kyurem-B is typically used as a late-game wincon on offense teams after its would-be checks such as Primal Groudon, Necrozma-DM, and Ho-Oh lose the ability to check it. Kyurem-B can also be used mid-game to break through balance teams due to the difficulty other teams have switching in. Kyurem-B often forces the other team to use their Terastallization to check it. Kyurem-B typically fits best on offense teams, especially hyper offense teams. However, Kyurem-B's downsides can make it difficult to justify on a team, as it often relies on Terastallization to perform its sweep, it competes with other setup sweepers such as Necrozma-DM and Mega Salamence, and it's weak to Stealth Rock.
  • Icicle Spear is Kyurem-B's best Ice-type STAB move, serving as consistent high damage output using Loaded Dice. Icicle Spear is a spammable STAB move due to the tier's abundance of Dragon- and Ground-type Pokemon. At +1 with a Jolly nature, Icicle Spear gets guaranteed 2HKOs on Ho-Oh and offensive Primal Groudon with a chance to 2HKO utility Arceus formes. With an Adamant nature, Icicle Spear can guarantee the 2HKO on utility Arceus formes and become very likely to 2HKO defensive Primal Groudon.
  • Fusion Bolt lets Kyurem-B hit all of the targets that resist Icicle Spear for at least neutral damage. Fusion Bolt 2HKOes defensive Primal Kyogre without needing to use Dragon Dance first. In addition, at +1, Kyurem-B has a chance to OHKO defensive Primal Kyogre and defensive Ho-Oh, and it can beat Dondozo or force it to Terastallize. Fusion Bolt is also Kyurem-B's best coverage move against Necrozma-DM.
  • Substitute lets Kyurem-B dodge status conditions, particularly Toxic from Pokemon such as Alomomola and Primal Groudon, which may threaten to stop its sweep, while also making switching to handle Kyurem-B risky. Kyurem-B's Substitute can survive weaker hits as well such as Giratina-O's Shadow Sneak. In addition, Substitute lets Kyurem-B bypass Trick and Charm from Gothitelle and Imposter from Ditto.
  • Scale Shot can be used as a secondary STAB option, since it is a useful midground option, as defensive cores that combine to resist Icicle Spear and Fusion Bolt will often be hit neutrally by Scale Shot such as a core of Zygarde and Primal Kyogre, allowing you to get around needing to predict defensively. The Speed boost given by Scale Shot may also come in handy, as it allows Kyurem-B to boost past a faster Pokemon while still getting damage such as an opposing Deoxys-A in the back that would threaten to revenge kill it at +1.
  • Tera Electric bolsters the power of Fusion Bolt while also turning incoming Steel-type attacks from a weakness into a resistance. This is incredibly useful in the Necrozma-DM matchup, as Fusion Bolt can 2HKO defensive Necrozma-DM, while Sunsteel Strike from defensive Necrozma-DM can 4HKO Kyurem-B after Stealth Rock, which notably doesn't break Kyurem-B's Substitute. In addition, Tera Electric gives Kyurem-B a favorable roll to OHKO Zacian-C if one layer of Spikes is up.
  • Tera Fairy is a defensive Terastallization option, most notably flipping Dragon-type moves such as Eternatus's Dynamax Cannon from a weakness into an immunity while also turning Fighting-type moves from a weakness into a resistance such as Marshadow's Low Kick.
  • Tera Ground + Tera Blast in the third moveslot hits the Steel-types that Kyurem-B normally struggles to break through, most notably Necrozma-DM, while also letting it threaten Terastallized Giratina-O, as Teravolt lets it ignore Levitate.
  • An EV spread of 40 HP / 252 Atk / 216 Spe with an Adamant nature lets Kyurem-B outspeed Adamant nature Zekrom and other neutral Speed nature Pokemon with a base 90 Speed. In addition, the bulk investment allows Kyurem-B to avoid an OHKO from Stone Edge from physical setup sweeper Arceus-Ground at +1.
  • The 252 Atk / 92 Def / 164 Spe EV spread with a Jolly nature allows Kyurem-B to outspeed Deoxys-A after a Dragon Dance while avoiding an OHKO from +2 Tera Normal Arceus's Extreme Speed and Ultra Necrozma's Stone Edge.
  • Kyurem-B is best used as a mid- or late-game sweeper. While Kyurem-B has usable bulk, enough to take a hit, its Stealth Rock weakness limits its ability to come onto the field, so it is fairly committal to send in. As such, reserve Kyurem-B for when you feel comfortable bringing it in such as in the face of a Pokemon it can hit super effectively.
  • Kyurem-B is also a fearsome wallbreaker, which gives it an important niche versus balance and stall teams. Kyurem-B can punish passive play by using Substitute against defensive Pokemon, which allows it to set up much more safely. Kyurem-B also has good matchups against keystone defensive Pokemon such as defensive Eternatus and Dondozo. Kyurem-B has to be careful about foes using defensive Terastallization to play around it and threaten it back.
  • Kyurem-B wants to use Terastallization often, so you should support Kyurem-B with Pokemon that don't rely on Terastallization such as Primal Groudon and Primal Kyogre. Kyurem-B also can force the other team to expend their Terastallization to beat it, removing some prediction for its teammates. Ho-Oh makes a great partner on bulkier offense teams, as it doesn't need to Terastallize that often, and it provides Defog support to remove Stealth Rock for Kyurem-B to come in more easily.
  • Sticky Web support from Smeargle or Shuckle is also great for Kyurem-B, as that allows it to leverage its passable but flawed Speed tier much better.
  • Kyurem-B struggles to break through Steel-types such as Necrozma-DM and Zacian-C, so one should pair Kyurem-B with attackers that can deal with them such as Primal Groudon, Ho-Oh, and Arceus-Ground.
